name: i.safe MOBILE IS540.1
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS540.1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ib) smartphone from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX, IECEx and UKEX, and for Class I Division 1 in North America. It runs Android 14, with 5G and a user-replaceable battery.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db

certification.northAmerica: NEC500: Class I, II, III Div 1 Groups A-G T4 (certificate number not found)

safety.conditions: Charge only outside hazardous areas with i.safe PROTECTOR 2.0 USB-C cable or approved equipment; accessories in Ex area only via ISM interface; approved microSD (IS-SD164.1 / IS-SD1128.1) or cards meeting entity parameters

specs.keys: Programmable red key (e.g. LWP); programmable left side key (e.g. PTT)

variants.name: IS540.M1
variants.description: Mining version, rated for Group I as well as Zone 1/21.
variants.marking: I M1 Ex ia I Ma

variants.name: Nokia IS540.1
variants.description: Sold by Nokia as part of its private wireless offer, with Nokia apps such as Team Comms. Same device and certificates as the IS540.1.

unconfirmed.specs.camera: From i.safe MOBILE's datasheet; a distributor sheet lists 40 MP.
unconfirmed.specs.sim: From i.safe MOBILE; a distributor sheet lists dual micro-SIM.
unconfirmed.capabilities.Thermal imaging: Not confirmed by the maker for this exact model.
